query:
with next as (
            select id from products
            where sales_start > now() - '5 minutes'::interval
            and sales_start <= now() + '40 seconds'::interval
            and tickets_been_released = false
            and kind = 'ticket'
            order by id
            limit 1
            for update skip locked
        )
        update products kind
        set tickets_been_released = true
        from next
        where kind.id = next.id
        returning kind.id
